name: consensus_score
description: Quality-weighted consensus across the 5 sub-models on the same rank scale as the sub-models. Calibrated against a reference library of 50K drug-like molecules so that a score of 0.65 is better than 99% of them. Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_single_point_0
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL single-point low-data catch-all pool of 39 assays (191 compounds). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_dose_response_0
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL dose-response signal-based pool of 77 assays (1284 compounds). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_dose_response_1
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL dose-response signal-based pool of 111 assays (1281 compounds). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_dose_response_2
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL dose-response signal-based pool of 67 assays (634 compounds; incl. 132 added negatives). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_dose_response_3
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL dose-response signal-based pool of 65 assays (492 compounds; incl. 91 added negatives). Recommended threshold: 0.65.
